hero.title: Dedicated to Transforming Smiles Since 2012
hero.desc1: DentaCare was founded on a simple belief: that dental care should be as comfortable as it is effective. Over the past 12 years, we have grown into one of New York's most trusted stomatology centers, treating over 8,400 patients.
